{{Quote|Close to the temple, near the sea, she can feel the Force ebbing and flowing through everything—the air she breathes, the sights she sees, and all that makes up the beautiful scenery. Up at the Edge Forest, there's a primal wildness to the Force that sets her blood pumping.|Lanoree Brock reflects on the forest's Force signature|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
The '''Edge Forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on the southern coast of the continent [[Masara]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The [[Je'daii]] temple of [[Bodhi]] was near the forest. 

==History==
In her childhood, [[Lanoree Brock]] and her family lived close to this forest, and her parents enjoyed taking strolls to its boundaries. For Lanoree and her parents, the scenery was not just beautiful, but even more exhilarating because through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], they could keenly sense the primal essence of life that permeated the forest's myriad wildlife and flora. But Lanoree's brother [[Dalien Brock]], who rejected the Force, was unwilling to share the sensation. At the age of nine, he would always cry when they reached the borders of the forest due to his family's indifference towards his feelings.
